fields.statement: At 6a7e233b: .github/workflows/ci.yml has only the pull_request trigger (push removed) and concurrency group ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} with cancel-in-progress: true. New internal/ciworkflow/ciworkflow_test.go reads ci.yml and asserts pull_request is the only trigger, the group contains github.event.pull_request.number, and cancel-in-progress is true. go test -count=1 -v ./internal/ciworkflow: both tests PASS. Negative check in a scratch copy: adding a push trigger, setting cancel-in-progress false, or keying the group on github.ref each fails the matching test. The package is in go list ./..., and make test ran it (ok internal/ciworkflow). fmt-check and vet pass. The rest of make check was red for reasons outside this leaf: timing budgets (modelapp TestGeneratedModel, then api TestReadBudget) flaked under machine load ~7-8 on 4 CPUs, and self-check flagged stale .rhiza/rendered for actor records the run committed.
